title: TripConfig
description: Vehicle and trip inputs for one optimization query. Experiments that vary initial SOC in percent convert to kWh before writing this file. Edge energy is c times distance_miles and is not stored on the graph.

origin.description: Node id of the trip origin in canonical_graph.json.

destination.description: Node id of the trip destination in canonical_graph.json.

battery_capacity_kwh.description: Usable battery capacity B in kWh. Discretization rounds this down.

initial_soc_kwh.description: Initial battery energy b0 in kWh. Discretization rounds this down.

reserve_kwh.description: Minimum battery reserve r in kWh. Discretization rounds this up.

consumption_kwh_per_mile.description: Fixed energy-consumption rate c in kWh per mile.

soc_step_kwh.description: SOC discretization step Delta E in kWh.
